sourceNotes.referenceTitle: Crescent Moon Cutout Gold Stainless Steel Hoop Earrings
sourceNotes.rawContent:
Striking and architectural — our Crescent Moon Cutout Hoop Earrings feature a bold teardrop-shaped gold hoop with oval cutouts carved along the lower edge, creating a crescent moon-like effect. High-gloss finish, clean lines, and an unmistakable silhouette — a modern statement piece.
- 316L Stainless Steel — rust-proof, tarnish-proof & skin-safe
- Gold-plated finish — rich, long-lasting shine
- Waterproof & sweat-resistant — built for everyday wear
- Oval cutout pattern — crescent moon inspired design
- High-gloss finish — bold and eye-catching
Pairs with: Solid ethnic wear, blazers, co-ords, and monochrome outfits.
Stainless steel is highly durable and water-resistant. Avoid prolonged exposure to harsh chemicals and perfumes.
